The map labels, legend ('Légende', ...) and the orange 'ZONAGE DE LA R.B.M.H' area table are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/3331000424. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large park entrance board in Ouagadougou on a steel frame, with a painted park map below. The Mooré name has a tilde on the A (BÃNGR); the usual map spelling is Bangr-Weoogo. The small strapline is transcribed as seen ('Education' shows no accent; spacing around the first hyphen as on the board). Distractors: 'BURKINA FASO / Unité-Progrès-Justice' with the coat of arms at top right, 'COMMUNE DE OUAGADOUGOU', the round park logo and the tiny map labels.

author: Tidjanehema
attribution: Photo: Tidjanehema, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Plaque_Entr%C3%A9e_D%C3%B4mes.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue name strip under a large dark picture board at the entrance to the Fabédougou domes site near Banfora; moderately small in frame. A tourist pictogram sits at the strip's left; the red STOP sign at upper left and the picnic pictogram at right are distractors.

author: Ji-Elle
attribution: Photo: Ji-Elle, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ouagadougou-H%C3%B4tel_du_Maire_(1).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Long white metal panel on a wall, Ouagadougou; green 'HOTEL DU MAIRE' (no accent) between two AMBF logos (A and M in red, BF in green) with a Burkina Faso outline.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/4085806167. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red-bordered French-style town entry sign above a 50 speed-limit sign on the roadside. The 50 roundel and the truck's plate are distractors.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/3581216910. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow-on-white supermarket sign on the right of the building, Ouagadougou. The phone line is small; spacing within the numbers is approximate. The Bridel/Catch product billboards on the facade and the faded 'SCIMAS SUPERMARCHE' lettering on the awning are distractors.

author: SuSanA Secretariat
attribution: Photo: SuSanA Secretariat, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_-_Pancarte_(3267234074).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

expect.query: Centre de Valorisation des Déchets Plastiques

notes: Hand-painted facility sign, Ouagadougou; initial letters in red, the rest black; no accents painted (PROPRETE, DECHETS, REGION). The I in 'VILLE DE TURIN' is faded. Small logos between the lines carry no extra legible text.

author: Dave Proffer
attribution: Photo: Dave Proffer, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Africa0703-0642a_-_Flickr_-_Dave_Proffer.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black hotel sign on posts, Bujumbura; all lower case; 'du' is drawn over a beige Africa silhouette. A row of facility pictograms ('24h', ...) hangs below. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arthur Nkunzimana
attribution: Photo: Arthur Nkunzimana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Never_give_up_shop.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted shop name across the top of a blue-grey shop front, Rumonge; 'USIKATE TAMAA' ('don't lose hope') runs vertically down the right edge, one letter per line. Mixed case as painted ('never Give up SHOP'). The small painted phone number, the 'BOUTIQUE ...' sign at left and the drinks list are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arthur Nkunzimana
attribution: Photo: Arthur Nkunzimana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boutique_Ibintu_ni_Imana.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted name on a white shop wall, Rumonge; the same name is repeated smaller on the side wall. Distractors: 'LUMICASH EcoCash' mobile-money adverts, the 'LAVAGE VEHICULES / CAR WASH / TUNAOSHA GARI' board and the 'CPVV FBP' ministry board in front. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arthur Nkunzimana
attribution: Photo: Arthur Nkunzimana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Butike_kaze_muronke_yo_mu_Nkayamba.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small roadside shop in Nkayamba (Rumonge): blue-painted 'BOUTIQUE' over the door and, on the side wall, the hand-painted name 'Kaze Muronke' with a Kirundi list of goods (rice, beans, oil, soap, salt, airtime units). A yellow Lumitel/Lumicash sticker and a tiny painter's credit are distractors. Two women seated at the shop are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Butike kaze muronke yo mu Nkayamba.jpg

author: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard
attribution: Photo: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Supr%C3%AAme_bar_restaurant_i.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Lettering painted along a white perimeter wall across the street, tilted; 'SUPREME' in black, 'BAR' in red, 'RESTAURANT' in yellow (no accent painted). Tiny text above ('MUSIC & PIANO BAR', 'RESTAURANT', 'PARTY H...') is too small to transcribe; the 'SUPREME BAR' logo board above is a repeat.

author: greyfalcon33
attribution: Photo: greyfalcon33, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hospital_Entrance_Sign_for_Kibuye_Hope_Hospital_in_Burundi.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White hospital name board on a brick wall with the Free Methodist logo. The red Kirundi motto is in guillemets; spacing around the final full stop and » is approximate. Accents are omitted on the sign ('HOPITAL', 'EGLISE', 'METHODISTE').
source_title: File:Hospital Entrance Sign for Kibuye Hope Hospital in Burundi.jpg

author: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard
attribution: Photo: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Restaurant_Eden.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted sandwich board with a green arrow pointing left, Gitega; tilted, and the photographer's fingertip covers the lower part of 'Ed'. Another 'RESTAURANT Eden' board at upper left and a truck plate at right are distractors.

author: Ntahonsigaye
attribution: Photo: Ntahonsigaye, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bienvenue_%C3%A0_la_R%C3%A9serve_Naturelle_de_Rumonge.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: SAUVEGARDONS CETTE FORET POUR UN AVENIR MEILLEUR

notes: Welcome board with the Burundi coat of arms and OBPE logo; the brackets around NYAMIRAMBO are red. Alternative query: 'Nyamirambo'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Bienvenue à la Réserve Naturelle de Rumonge.jpg

author: Ntahonsigaye
attribution: Photo: Ntahonsigaye, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%C3%80_la_d%C3%A9couverte_de_la_beaut%C3%A9_de_la_R%C3%A9serve_Naturelle_Karonda.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside welcome board on the RN3 near Rumonge, with painted baboon and bird; coat of arms and OBPE logo in the top corners. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:À la découverte de la beauté de la Réserve Naturelle Karonda.jpg

author: Alain Fortuné14
attribution: Photo: Alain Fortuné14, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Burundi_is_Really_Beautiful_(7).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small blue street-name plate with white border on a compound wall at right, Bujumbura; very small in frame and oversaturated. A third line with a numeric code (looks like '10 01 03') is not reliably legible and is left out. The tiny house-number plate by the gate is a distractor.

author: Alain Fortuné14
attribution: Photo: Alain Fortuné14, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:AmAzing_BURUNDI_(34).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Shop fascia in Bujumbura photographed tilted about 35 degrees with heavily boosted colours; food photos crowd the board. The small script lines under the name (bakery/grocery words) are left out. A second board on the left shows the same name with 'Avenue de Grèce N° 19', and a blue street plate 'AVENUE DE GRECE' with a code number stands in front; both are distractors.

author: Kibengado
attribution: Photo: Kibengado, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:La_rivi%C3%A8reRuvubu_03.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black river-name sign with three white wave lines, beside the Ruvubu river (Karusi province).

author: Gashi.bdi
attribution: Photo: Gashi.bdi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A_sign_in_the_entry_of_bururi_natural_reserve.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Title of a large information board (French in black, Kirundi in blue) with coat of arms and World Bank logo. The Kirundi rules list, the slogan band and the PRRPB project text below are distractors; the board's lower edge is torn.
source_title: File:A sign in the entry of bururi natural reserve.jpg

author: Zamennest
attribution: Photo: Zamennest, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Indication_des_chutes_de_karera_%C3%A0_rutana.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow lettering painted on a green concrete block at the Karera falls site, Rutana: 'Welcome to the very beautiful falls of Karera' in Kirundi.
source_title: File:Indication des chutes de karera à rutana.jpg

author: Zamennest
attribution: Photo: Zamennest, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Indication_et_bureau_des_failles_des_allemands_%C3%A0_kiguhu,Rutana.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: MINISTERE DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT, DE L’AGRICULTURE ET DE
OFFICE BURUNDAIS POUR LA PROTECTION DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT
KAZE MU BIMANGA VY’ INYAKAZU / VY’ABADAGI
BIENVENUE AUX FAILLES DE NYAKAZU / DES ALLEMANDS

notes: Green trilingual (French/Kirundi/English) welcome board at the Nyakazu faults (Failles des Allemands), Rutana; seen at an angle. 'MINISTERE' and 'DE' are run together on the board. Apostrophes are typographic (’). The French descriptive paragraph below the paintings and the partner logos (BIOPAMA, EU flag) are distractors.
source_title: File:Indication et bureau des failles des allemands à kiguhu,Rutana.jpg

author: TheSokks
attribution: Photo: TheSokks, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Street_sign_on_Sal_Island.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stack of four white arrow-shaped direction signs at a junction on Sal; the signs are small in a tall frame with lots of sky. 'do' in 'Pedra do Lume' is in small type; the last sign has an airplane pictogram. The map usually spells the village 'Pedra de Lume'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Waldyrious
attribution: Photo: Waldyrious, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pachamama_eco-park_name_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Carved wooden board on a green mesh gate at the eco-park in Sal. The opening-hours plaque and no-dogs pictogram below are left out. Bougainvillea leaves overlap the right edge without hiding text. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Jardim Botânico Viveiro Ilha do Sal

author: Cayambe
attribution: Photo: Cayambe, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cidade_Velha_info_panel_UNESCO_2011.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Sun-bleached UNESCO candidacy board in Cape Verdean Creole (ALUPEC spelling, ISO 639-3 'kea'). Faint repeated background text ('CIDADE VELHA', other heritage cities) and a torn lower-left corner; the slogan at the bottom ('...DI NÓS TUDU!') is partly missing and left out. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Ribeira Grande de Santiago in the 21st century
World Heritage Site signs in Cape Verde

author: Somada
attribution: Photo: Somada, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Avenida_Liberdade_Assomada.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large white 3D letters on a road median in Assomada, slightly blurred and at an angle; the letters sit close together with no clear gap between words. 'CVTelecom' and 'Medicalia' signs on the building behind are distractors.
source_categories: 3D letter place name signs in Cape Verde

author: Somada
attribution: Photo: Somada, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sinal%C3%A9tica.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: 'I [red heart] SOMADA' 3D letters on a roadside rock cut at the entry to Assomada (Creole 'Somada'); the heart is a symbol, not a letter. Hazy light; a tiny plate to the right of the letters is unreadable.
source_categories: 3D letter place name signs in Cape Verde

author: Adriao
attribution: Photo: Adriao, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Casario_em_Rabil.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Three arrow-shaped direction signs at a cobbled junction in Rabil, Boa Vista, shot through a vehicle window (light streaks and reflections). 'de' in 'praia de Chaves' is small; the brown sign has a beach pictogram. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Popenguine05
attribution: Photo: Popenguine05, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Classic_road_to_Cavo.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Tourist direction panel with brown/white/blue rows, pictograms and up arrows, Porto Novo (Santo Antão). Sun glare washes the top row. The small 'CABO VERDE Santo Antão' logo text at the bottom is left out; 'Porto Novo' is in small type at the bottom right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Santo Antão (Cape Verde) in the 21st century

author: Adriao
attribution: Photo: Adriao, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Praia_da_Varandinha.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Heavily rusted beach sign on Boa Vista. The initial 'P' of 'Praia' is rusted away and left out, rust blotches cross 'Varandinha' and 'Bracona', and the top-left corner is eaten through.

author: Adriao
attribution: Photo: Adriao, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ervat%C3%A3o.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rusty-edged beach name sign on two posts, Boa Vista. Scratched graffiti (names, dates) and two stickers around the name are distractors.

author: Gagum from Lisbon, Portugal
attribution: Photo: Gagum from Lisbon, Portugal, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tarrafal_concentration_camp_(7).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large Ministério da Cultura site board with a plan of the camp and a numbered legend (LEGENDA 1-25: ADMINISTRAÇÃO/DIRECTOR, TORRES DE VIGIA, ...); only the title lines are the target. The sign says 'DE TARRAFAL'; the site is usually mapped as 'Campo de Concentração do Tarrafal'.

author: Felitsata
attribution: Photo: Felitsata, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Deserto_de_Viana_with_Sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small rectangular name sign half-buried in a sand dune on Boa Vista, tilted and partly crossed by dry branches; the lower right corner is chipped.

author: Joehawkins
attribution: Photo: Joehawkins, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Santo_Ant%C3%A3o,_Nov._2022_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Single wooden hiking fingerpost (trail PR 2) on Santo Antão, shot from below; red 'PR 2 SARG' tag at the left end, small hiker pictogram and trail colours at the arrow tip.
source_categories: Hiking and footpath signs in Cape Verde

author: christing-O-
attribution: Photo: christing-O-, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/76187282@N00/7538444806. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: A, B, C, D, E, F, T

notes: Stencil-painted yellow board for a driving school in Douala, written without accents (ECOLE, SPECIALISTE, CATEGORIE). The board continues below the frame; only the top of 'OUVERT DU' is visible and the opening hours are cut off. A second dark sign at right ('ECOLE ... ST...') is cut off and is a distractor.

author: Jean-Louis Heckly
attribution: Photo: Jean-Louis Heckly, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yaound%C3%A9_(Tsinga)-Enseigne_de_menuiserie_en_mai_1974.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: M ENUISERIE SPECIALE DE L'ERE MODERNE
TOURS A BOIS INCRUTATION DES FILETS

notes: Hand-painted joinery workshop banner between two wooden posts, Tsinga, Yaoundé, 1974 slide (faded colour). Spellings as painted ('MODENE', 'DUTEMPS', 'INCRUTATION'; a gap after the first M of 'MENUISERIE'). The decorative letters make line 3 hard. Two smaller lines below are left out as unreliable: they read approximately 'BRASURE DES SCIES A RUBAN INSIGNES D' HABITS' and '450 M AU FOND DERNIER POTEAU ELECTRIQUE' / 'STYLE EXIGE'. A red arrow points right.

author: Le Zeno
attribution: Photo: Le Zeno, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emi_money.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: Ouvert de Lundi à Samedi 07h30 - 17h30, même les jours fé

notes: Red money-transfer shop fascia, Ndogbong, Douala, shot in dim light through a vehicle window. Line 3 starts behind a black banner (the hidden word probably 'Agence'); the last line is cut at the right edge ('fé[riés]'); a tiny registration number line at left is illegible. Alternative query: 'Emi Money'. The ADVANS board, the Emi money kiosk and the Ria sticker are distractors.

author: Minette Lontsie
attribution: Photo: Minette Lontsie, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Road_sign_33_Km_de_Dschang.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Distance band at the foot of a '33' Export beer billboard on the road to Dschang, shot from a moving vehicle. The '33' in quotes sits in a red roundel with a football over 'KM'. The beer advert above ('LES MEILLEURS MOMENTS SE CÉLÈBRENT AVEC', bottle labels) is a distractor.

author: Minette Lontsie
attribution: Photo: Minette Lontsie, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Votre_pharmacie_Douala.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Bright green raised letters on a dark hanging panel, Douala; close and frontal.

author: AfricaTravelAssociation
attribution: Photo: AfricaTravelAssociation, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_Post_to_Bimbia_Slave_Port.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stencilled roadside direction sign; 'III' is a small red Roman numeral; the distance is in a red arrow pointing right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sign Post to Bimbia Slave Port.jpg

author: Adesolive
attribution: Photo: Adesolive, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tole_Tea_Estate_sign_post.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small dark direction board in front of a tea field near Buea, far from the camera; a CDC logo sits between the lines and a power line crosses the board. Arrow points right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Simbanematick
attribution: Photo: Simbanematick, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ville_de_Nkoteng.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red-bordered French-style town entry sign on two posts; slightly washed out.

author: Bdx
attribution: Photo: Bdx, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Welcome_sign_on_Ndawara_tea_plantation.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Weathered white billboard with brown raised letters in mid-distance; 'NDAWARA TEA ESTATE' is arched around an N tea-leaf logo. Village houses and tea hills behind.
source_title: File:Welcome sign on Ndawara tea plantation.JPG

author: Zakalingba
attribution: Photo: Zakalingba, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Avenue_Pr_Faustin_Archange_TOUADERA_001.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: White street-name panel on a green post, Bangui; 'Avenue' is printed in grey, the rest in black. The lower half has a faded Sango/French slogan (roughly 'Bata Bangui Nzoni / Maintenons Bangui Propre') that is too washed out to transcribe; event posters below are distractors.
source_categories: Street signs in the Central African Republic

author: Kondotikodro
attribution: Photo: Kondotikodro, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bureau_Croix_Rouge_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: MINISTERE DE LA SANTE PUBLIQUE DE LA POPULATION
DIRECTION DE LA REGION SANITAIRE N° 7
TOUS LES JOURS DE LUNDI A VENDREDI

notes: White board on posts in front of a health office, 5e arrondissement, Bangui; header in black, vaccination notice in blue; the 'A' in '0 A 11' is small. Small motto 'Unité - Dignité - Travail' under the flag and the GAVI/OMS/unicef logos are left out. A sun flare crosses the top-left. Red Cross ambulances at left are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

International Committee of the Red Cross in the Central African Republic
Medical buildings in the Central African Republic
Signs in the Central African Republic

author: Kondotikodro
attribution: Photo: Kondotikodro, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Village_chutes_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black letters painted on a yellow building facade beside a green 'NZONI GANGO NA BEAFRIKA' logo. A flagpole hides the last letter of 'SITE' and the C of 'CHUTES'. The small coloured contact lines below (BP, phone numbers, website) are partly hidden and left out.
source_categories: Signs in the Central African Republic

lil-madaris / lil-safar / li-rijal al-a'mal (for schools / travel / businessmen)
taslih jami' anwa' al-haqa'ib (repair of all kinds of bags)

notes: Weathered red painted shop sign in Amman, partly in diagonal shadow; heading is in stylised calligraphy (the alif-lam of 'الشرق' is merged into the flourish). Bottom row: '١٨٣٨٠١' follows an envelope icon (P.O. Box); the telephone number after the phone icon is in shadow and too faded to read with certainty, so it is omitted. Not transcribed: a tiny painter's signature under 'مصنع', and the yellow roundel on the left ('لطفاً: دخلة خاصة ممنوع الوقوف', private entrance, no parking), which is a distractor.

lines.text: FALELOTU SENITULI ʻOE SIASI ʻO TONGA TAUʻATAINA.
THE CENTENNIAL CHURCH OF THE FREE CHURCH OF TONGA.

notes: Bilingual Tongan/English granite foundation tablet at the Centennial Church (Free Church of Tonga), Nukuʻalofa. Only the two headings and their date lines are transcribed; the body paragraphs (founding by King Siaosi Tupou I, foundation stone by King Taufaʻahau Tupou IV, donors) are long commemorative text. The glottal stops are engraved as small slanted ticks, transcribed as U+02BB (ʻ). Date separator is a dash-colon-dash ornament.

lines.text: TAUTEFITO KI HE MOA, PUAKA ETC.

notes: Hand-painted farm sign on ʻEua, 1991 slide scan (black slide border and '91 3 31' date imprint are not part of the sign).
